aditya: noticing GPU attach queue spiking on gnode-usw2-12 during scale-up, suspect local nvme IO hotpath.
clara: which device?
aditya: nvme0n1. quick iostat: ```
iostat -x 1 2
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rsec/s wsec/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1 0.00 0.00 0.00 220.0 0 11000 50.0 7.2 88.4 1.50 99.8
```
jen: avgqu-sz 7.2 and await 88ms. Any janitor activity?
aditya: janitor started a medium-scan at 7322001090 with concurrency=3. SMART temp ~76C.
srebot: scrub-throttle-controller: policy unchanged.
clara: short term - pause janitor on that host and drain new GPU attaches.
aditya: pausing janitor now - API returned 202. initiating drain for new allocs.
jen: note cost impact for moving to fallback pool, but acceptable to avoid timeouts.
aditya: after pause await dropped to ~14ms and attach retries cleared within 5m. will open INF ticket and propose janitor health-gates (temp & active-gpu-backlog).
clara: file INF and add alert for avgqu-sz>5 when gpu_provision_backlog>2.
aditya: done - INF-4120. closing thread once PR for janitor gate is up.
